summary: CQRS-028: Map URT campaign metadata to Planfile and deduplicate import

delivery.outcome: Deliver CQRS-028 (semcod/planfile#431) in planfile/sync/urt_campaign_import.py and tests/test_urt_campaign_import.py: raw BACKLOG.json payload guard, tracking vs target repository separation, URT/intent/proposal metadata mapping, verified planfile.sync.receipts GitHub issue binding, and idempotent/revision-conflict-aware preview and import commit.
nonGoals: Do not modify planfile/core/store.py, sqlite_index.py, or index_repair.py.
Do not guess unknown target repositories or accept unverified GitHub issue numbers.
Do not perform live GitHub issue creation inside mapping/preview.

architecture.decision: Add standalone planfile/sync/urt_campaign_import.py reusing planfile.sync.receipts.latest_ticket_receipts for verified readback lookup and atomic JSON state/receipt writes, with full unit tests in tests/test_urt_campaign_import.py.
architecture.rollback: Abort import on UrtCampaignRevisionConflictError preserving prior state/receipts, or remove additive planfile/sync/urt_campaign_import.py and tests/test_urt_campaign_import.py.

validation.evidence: assert_not_raw_backlog_payload rejects unmapped BACKLOG.json manifests and raw proposal payloads.
Identical content yields noop_duplicate; changed content without bumped plan_revision raises UrtCampaignRevisionConflictError without mutating state.
tracking_repository stays separate and unknown/nieustalone target candidates map to None with routing_status=unrouted.
original_phrase, urt_ref, temporal_intent, and proposal_accepted=False are retained cleanly.
linked_github_issue binds only verified succeeded receipts from planfile.sync.receipts and ignores unverified raw hints.
